howItWorks.step1Desc: Browse marinas across 20+ Mediterranean countries. Filter by location, dates, boat size, and amenities. Three layers: Premium (verified), Concierge (we book for you), and Explore (full directory).

howItWorks.step4Desc: Dock safely with full marina details: berths, max LOA, draft, VHF channel, contact info. Rate your experience to help fellow sailors. Premium members enjoy priority booking and up to 25% off.

about.missionText: We're on a mission to connect sailors with mooring owners, making Mediterranean sailing more affordable and accessible for everyone.
about.storyP1: It all started on a hot summer day in 2022, somewhere between Split and Hvar. After hours of sailing, we couldn't find an affordable place to moor for the night.
about.storyP2: "Why isn't there an Airbnb for moorings?" That simple question became our obsession.
about.storyP3: Mooring Booking was born from that frustration. We built the platform we wished existed.
about.storyP4: Today we aim to list 10,000+ moorings and marina berths across Croatia, Greece, Italy, France, Spain, Turkey, Albania, Malta, Cyprus, and Slovenia.
about.storyP5: This is just the beginning. Our vision is to make every mooring and marina berth in the Mediterranean accessible to every sailor.
about.passionDesc: Founded by sailors, for sailors. We understand the joy of finding the perfect mooring after a long day on the water.
about.trustDesc: Every mooring owner is verified. Secure payments protect both sailors and providers.
about.communityDesc: We're building more than a marketplace - we're creating a community of Mediterranean sailors.
about.qualityDesc: Our rating system ensures only the best moorings rise to the top. No hidden fees, no surprises.
about.feature1: Now4Today — Same-day bookings (01:00 – 23:00) with an instant 20% increase for urgent availability
about.feature2: AI Captain — Your personal sailing assistant: weather, navigation, mooring guides, tourist info, restaurants, and fuel stations
about.feature3: Custom Daily Pricing — Providers set flexible per-day rates via calendar controls
about.feature4: Mooring Insurance — Optional third-party liability protection for just €9.99/year
about.feature5: Up to 50% off — Providers can offer 0–50% discounts on standard rates
about.feature6: Marketing Tools & Premium Listing — Boost visibility with QR codes, affiliate links, and priority search placement
about.feature7: Partner Discounts — Because we negotiate discounts from our partners, mooring prices are sure to be more affordable than standard rates

faq.bookQ1: How do I book a mooring?
faq.bookA1: Search your desired location and dates, select a mooring, and click 'Book Now'. You'll receive instant confirmation after payment.
faq.bookA2: Yes, most moorings offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Check the cancellation policy on each mooring page.
faq.bookQ3: When do I get the navigation coordinates?
faq.bookA3: GPS coordinates and exact location details are unlocked immediately after booking confirmation and payment processing.
faq.bookQ4: How do I navigate to my booked mooring?
faq.bookA4: After completing your booking, tap 'Navigate to Mooring' to open directions in your preferred maps app (Apple Maps, Android Maps, or OpenStreetMap).
faq.bookQ5: What if the mooring doesn't match the description?
faq.bookA5: Contact AI Captain immediately for assistance. Our platform will mediate between you and the owner. We take listing accuracy seriously, however Intelligent Matrix operates as a marketplace and does not guarantee refunds.
faq.bookQ6: Can I extend my stay at the mooring?
faq.bookA6: Yes! Extensions are automatically approved if the mooring isn't booked by others for your requested dates. No waiting needed — the system checks availability instantly.
faq.payA1: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and Google Pay. Some moorings also accept cash payment on arrival (commission still applies).
faq.payA2: Yes, all payments are processed via Stripe with bank-grade encryption. We never store your full card details.
faq.payQ3: When does the mooring owner get paid?
faq.payA3: Owners receive payment 3-5 business days after guest checkout for card payments, minus the 12% platform commission.
faq.payQ4: Why do prices vary so much?
faq.payA4: Prices depend on location, season, amenities, and owner preferences. Now4Today bookings (within 48 hours) carry a 20% premium for urgent availability.
faq.payA5: No hidden fees! The price you see includes all platform fees. The only additional costs may be optional services offered by the mooring owner.
faq.ownerQ1: How do I list my mooring?
faq.ownerA1: Click 'Become a Provider', create an account, and follow the 10-step registration process. It takes about 10 minutes.
faq.ownerA2: We charge a flat 12% commission on all bookings. No monthly fees and no hidden costs. You can offer a 0-20% discount to users.
faq.ownerQ3: How do I manage my calendar?
faq.ownerA3: Access your provider dashboard to update availability, block dates, or set special peak season pricing.
faq.ownerQ4: What if a guest doesn't show up?
faq.ownerA4: You keep the full booking amount. Guests who don't cancel in time lose their payment per your cancellation policy.
faq.ownerA5: Payments are automatically transferred to your bank account 3-5 business days after each checkout. You receive a monthly report.
faq.ownerQ6: Can I set different prices for different seasons?
faq.ownerA6: Yes! Use the calendar in your dashboard to set peak season prices, off-season discounts, and event-specific pricing.
faq.marinaA1: Absolutely! Marinas and commercial providers can list unlimited moorings. Contact us for bulk upload tools.
faq.marinaA2: Yes, we offer API access for marinas with existing booking systems. Contact our tech team for documentation.
faq.marinaA3: All providers must have valid liability insurance. We verify marina certificates during the registration process.
faq.affQ1: How does the affiliate program work?
faq.affA1: Sign up for free, get your unique tracking link, and earn 15% of our platform's 12% fee for every booking.
faq.affQ2: How long does the tracking cookie last?
faq.affA2: Our tracking cookie lasts 30 days. If someone clicks your link and books within 30 days, you earn a commission.
faq.affQ3: What are the minimum payout requirements?
faq.affA3: Minimum payout is €50. Payments are processed monthly via Stripe or bank transfer. Elite affiliates get weekly payouts.
faq.affQ4: Can I promote on social media?
faq.affA4: Yes! We encourage promotion on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, blogs, and email lists.
faq.safetyQ1: What if bad weather forces me to leave early?
faq.safetyA1: Contact the owner and our support immediately. Note: no refunds are available for early departure from a mooring, regardless of reason.
faq.safetyQ2: Does the app provide weather forecasts?
faq.safetyA2: Yes! Our AI Captain provides real-time weather data, wind speed alerts, and wave conditions for your mooring location.
faq.safetyA3: We require all providers to declare that their moorings meet safety standards. Verified moorings undergo periodic inspections.
faq.subA1: We offer three tiers: Basic (free), Premium Monthly (€20/mo), and Premium Annual (€8.25/mo, billed €99/year).
faq.subQ2: Do I need to register to use the app?
faq.subA2: Yes, free registration is required for all users. You can start with the free Basic plan and upgrade anytime.
faq.subA3: Yes! You can upgrade from Basic to Premium at any time. Downgrading takes effect at the end of your current billing period.
faq.subQ4: What does Premium include that Basic doesn't?
faq.subA4: Premium unlocks unlimited AI Captain, 7-day weather forecasts, offline maps, storm alerts, maneuvering guides, priority booking, and much more.
faq.techQ1: How do I reset my password?
faq.techA1: Click 'Forgot Password' on the sign-in page. You'll receive an email with a reset link.
faq.techQ2: Can I use the app offline?
faq.techA2: Premium members have offline access to maps, weather forecasts (24h cache), navigation guides, and saved bookings.
faq.techQ3: How do I delete my account?
faq.techA3: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Active bookings must be completed or cancelled. Data is deleted within 30 days per GDPR.
